cues.text: A dark, rocky wasteland stretches toward a distant ridge. Above it, a brilliant teal nebula and a small red moon illuminate the starry sky.
A colony ship streaks down from the upper left, a brilliant point of white light trailing across the heavens.
It descends toward the lifeless terrain, bringing the first spark of movement to a barren world.

beats.note: A dark, rocky, cratered landscape under a bright teal nebula and starry sky. A red moon is visible on the right. A bright dot appears in the upper left.
The bright dot, a colony ship, descends across the sky towards the horizon.
The ship continues its descent, nearing the dark horizon of the lifeless planet.
The ship disappears behind the horizon. The scene begins to fade to black.
